frame: bisector frame of datasets/biphenyl-synthetic/generate.py: z along the inter-ring axis (ring A at z < 0), x bisects the two ring planes, y = z × x; the tensor is diagonal there with free Szz and Delta = Sxx − Syy
equivalences: At fixed labels (phi, Delta) and (-phi, Delta) are equivalent; (180 ± phi, -Delta) only together with the ring-B relabelling H2'<->H6', H3'<->H5'. Domain folded to [0, 90].
N_rule: N counts the 14 unique couplings; multiplicity (symmetry-copied) pairs never inflate N
likelihood: Gaussian, diagonal, known sigma = 0.5 Hz (not rescaled by chi2_nu)
optimum_convention: refined bounded optimum: best point of the grid 0:0.5:90 deg, refined by bounded 1-D minimisation of the VarPro profile objective over the neighbouring grid cells (xatol 1e-11 deg); the grid point itself is NOT the expected value

sanity_bounds_vs_check_fit_out.note: rounded prototype values are sanity bounds only

tolerances.note: plan v0.6 §8 M1; objective, interval and stderr tolerances added at the M0 freeze

coverage.noise: y_k = noiseless predictions of the 14 unique couplings + rng.normal(0, 0.5, size=14), in couplings.csv row order
coverage.interval: profile interval at raw delta chi2 = 1.00, one parameter at a time, other parameters re-minimised
coverage.band_note: about a 99% binomial band for n = 1000 at p = 0.683

gates.a_noiseless: fit noiseless.json -> recover truth within noiseless_recovery_atol; objective ~ 0
gates.b_regression: fit couplings.csv -> match noisy_fixture.json within the regression tolerances
gates.c_coverage: coverage over the seed ensemble within acceptance_band, for each parameter
gates.d_forward: forward.json: all 45 pairs, reversed pairs and the 0/90 deg endpoints
gates.e_jump: see the 8CB expected set (explicit four-conformer average == relabelling shortcut)
